findings.problem: parse::<u32>().unwrap() panics when a line is not a valid u32 (empty string, non-numeric, out-of-range). Untrusted input can abort the process instead of returning a typed error.
findings.failure_mode: Any malformed line causes panic instead of graceful failure; no boundary validation on parse result.
findings.fix: Replace unwrap with a typed error return. Use parse::<u32>().map_err(MyError::InvalidScore)? or filter_map with explicit error collection. Return Result<Vec<u32>, ParseError> or similar.

findings.problem: unwrap is a forbidden construct in production reachable code per Holzman doctrine. It is present on the parse result.
findings.failure_mode: Panic on parse failure exposes process to abort on untrusted input.
findings.fix: Remove unwrap; return Result or handle parse failure explicitly.

findings.problem: parse::<u32>().unwrap() is a production assert equivalent that panics on invalid external input. This is a panic path in production-reachable code.
findings.failure_mode: Malformed input from untrusted sources causes panic; no typed error propagates.
findings.fix: Replace with ? operator returning Result, or filter_map to skip invalid lines with explicit logging.

findings.problem: Vec::collect() grows without declared maximum size, try_reserve call, or allocation budget. For untrusted input with many lines, this can exhaust memory.
findings.failure_mode: Unbounded heap growth on untrusted input; no graceful degradation or typed resource error.
findings.fix: Declare a maximum line count or byte size, use Vec::with_capacity or try_reserve, and return a typed allocation/resource error when the limit is exceeded.

findings.problem: No rust-toolchain.toml exists in the crate. Nightly Rust work requires a pinned dated nightly, rustfmt, clippy, rust-src, and llvm-tools-preview components.
findings.failure_mode: No reproducible toolchain; floating nightly is a policy violation.
findings.fix: Add rust-toolchain.toml with pinned nightly-YYYY-MM-DD channel and required components.

findings.failure_mode: No visibility into parse failure rate; silent data loss on malformed lines.
findings.fix: Return a structured result that preserves failure information or aggregates errors.
